evals.prompt: We found a reusable EEG diffusion debugging order, but the notes include a private local path and unpublished result. Compress this into durable memory.
evals.expected_output: A memory candidate that classifies the memory type, strips or reroutes private details, proposes a minimal public patch only for reusable behavior, and suggests an eval if behavior must be enforced.

assertions.text: Output includes the full Memory candidate block.
Output does not include private local paths or unpublished sensitive details in a public target.
Output explains whether an eval is needed.

evals.prompt: A user imported a private Zotero BIB library and wants it available to Paper-RAG++ without leaking local PDF paths or personal notes. Decide what enters public memory and what stays private.
evals.expected_output: A Zotero memory policy response that routes raw exports and private notes to ignored private storage, allows cleaned paper indexes and maps into public Paper-RAG++ references, and requires validation and eval updates.

assertions.text: Output keeps raw BIB exports, local PDF paths, personal notes, and unpublished judgments out of public files.
Output permits cleaned paper index, taxonomy, method map, dataset map, and claim-to-citation map as public memory.
Output includes a Memory candidate block.
Output requires validation before trusting generated memory.
